menu.title: Play a game
menu.description: Two short games about keeping servers up. Best scores are saved in this browser only.

snake.name: Packet Snake
snake.description: Steer a data packet to each payload, around firewalls and DDoS attacks.

typing.name: Terminal challenge
typing.description: The server is crashing. Type the fix commands before the timer runs out. Opens the terminal.

snake.title: Packet Snake
snake.intro: Route the packet to each payload. Avoid the edges, firewalls, DDoS attacks and your own trail.
snake.keys: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD. Space or P pauses and resumes. Escape closes the games. On a touch screen, swipe on the board or use the buttons.
snake.autoPaused: Paused while the page was in the background.

reason.self: The packet crossed its own trail.
reason.ddos: The packet ran into a DDoS attack.

snake.steadyHint: The packet moves slower and no longer speeds up as you score.
